name: discord-emojigen-mcp
description: Fetch Discord emoji references, upload bounded base64 or local-path images, and safely remove only emoji created by the authenticated bot.
long_description:
List emoji in one configured Discord server, optionally fetch a selected static emoji as base64 reference data for an external image generator, then prepare and upload exactly one base64/data-URL or bounded absolute-path/local-file-URI image. Successful upload returns a Discord mention ready for immediate use. This server does not generate images. Removal is stateless and allowed only when Discord reports that the authenticated bot created the emoji.

The Discord bot should receive only CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS. Do not grant MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS or Administrator.

discord_bot_token.title: Discord Bot Token
discord_bot_token.description: Bot token with CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS in the target guild

discord_guild_id.title: Discord Guild ID
discord_guild_id.description: The only Discord guild the server may access

allowed_image_roots.title: Allowed Image Roots
allowed_image_roots.description: OS path-list of absolute directories allowed for image_path; blank disables path uploads
